origin_paper.title: Biomimetic Mineralization of Keratin Scaffolds for Enamel Regeneration

cards.scope: A 2025 laboratory study used wool-derived keratin films to guide mineral growth on artificially demineralized, extracted human teeth. The repaired enamel showed changes in structure and mechanical properties. This was not a trial of treatment in patients or whole-tooth regrowth. Toothpaste and professionally applied gels were proposed future uses; clinical benefit and durability were not established by this study.

origin_paper.title: Biomimetic supramolecular protein matrix restores structure and properties of human dental enamel

cards.scope: A 2025 study used an elastin-like recombinamer matrix to guide mineral growth on extracted human enamel and dentine. Laboratory tests assessed the resulting structure and mechanical properties, including responses to wear and acid. This was not a clinical trial and did not show that lost whole teeth can regrow. The university reported a company aim to introduce a first product in 2026; that forecast does not establish clinical availability or benefit.
